name: feature-flag-dashboard
author: Suyash Pandey (https://github.com/EcstaticFly)
description: Feature flag dashboard monorepo: API, client SDK, admin dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/sdk && npm run test:e2e -w packages/dashboard
scripts.load:test: docker compose --profile load run --rm --no-deps k6 run /scripts/evaluate.js
